column1: Dataset S2. Genes differentially expressed in PAO1 ∆phrS cells with plasmid pEV (empty vector pKH6) compared to PAO1 ∆phrS cells with plasmid pPhrS (pEV vs pPhrS) and compared to PAO1 ∆phrS cells with plasmid pPhrS-∆seed (pEV vs pPhrS-∆seed) following a 20 minute pulse with 0.2% (w/v) final concentration of arabinose. Genes exhibiting a log-2 fold change greater than 1 (increased expression following pulsed expression of PhrS) or less than -1 (decreased expression following pulsed expression of PhrS) and having an adjusted P value ≤ 0.05 are reported on the 'Significant' pages as well as the full DESeq2 datasets for each comparison. The right-most column on the Significant pages indicate which of these genes were identified as being direct targets of PhrS by RIL-seq anlaysis.
